events.description: Monica Geller says the current situation is going fine.
Monica Geller says Ross Geller is great.
Monica Geller says Ross Geller is in a whole other place and that Ross Geller is gone from the current location.
Monica Geller says Judy Geller does not need to fly back.
Monica Geller says Judy Geller means that the birth happening now might be Judy Geller's only chance to see a grandchild being born.
Monica Geller tells Judy Geller to stop pressuring Monica Geller about babies.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is only 26 years old.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is not thinking about having babies yet.
Chandler Bing asks where Joey Tribbiani has been.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani just had a baby.
